description: A grocery with its whole front wall given over to a hand-painted price board, revised by wiping a column off with a rag and writing it again. Three trolleys are chained together by the door, more barricade than service. The window is stacked with vac-packed protein bricks in a pyramid, sun-faded on the side that gets the light, and nobody has turned them in a year. The door is east; Ironside Street runs west.
name: Ration Nine
